title: PP-Net: A Hybrid Physical-Prior Neural Network for Scattered Light Removal in Biomedical Images on Embedded Devices
abstract: arXiv:2609.26474v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scattered light is common in biomedical images, yet its removal remains challenging. The difficulty arises from three aspects: first, aligned scattered-light-free biomedical ground truth is often unavailable; second, scattering is coupled with weak illumination and sensor-induced noise; and third, many learning-based restoration models are computationally expensive for embedded devices in Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) scenarios. To address these issues, this paper proposes PP-Net, a hybrid physical-prior neural network for biomedical scattered light removal. The proposed method consists of three components: DFN-Net suppresses sensor-induced noise, ASAP estimates the scattering map and recovers a physics-based prior map, and GF-Net refines the prior map by fusing it with the denoised observation. To reduce the dependence on paired biomedical ground truth, a progressive synthetic training and cross-domain transfer strategy is develop

translated_title: PP-Net：一种面向嵌入式设备生物医学图像散射光去除的混合物理先验神经网络
translated_abstract: 散射光在生物医学图像中十分常见，但其去除仍然具有挑战性。困难主要来自三个方面：首先，对齐的无散射光生物医学真值通常难以获得；其次，散射与弱光照及传感器噪声相互耦合；第三，许多基于学习的图像恢复模型对于医疗物联网场景中的嵌入式设备而言计算成本过高。为解决这些问题，本文提出了PP-Net，一种用于生物医学散射光去除的混合物理先验神经网络。该方法由三个组件构成：DFN-Net用于抑制传感器引起的噪声，ASAP用于估计散射图并恢复基于物理的先验图，GF-Net通过将先验图与去噪后的观测图像融合来对其进行细化。为减少对成对生物医学真值的依赖，本文还开发了一种渐进式合成训练与跨域迁移策略。
tldr: 提出混合物理先验神经网络PP-Net，通过噪声抑制、散射图估计与融合细化三个模块协同去除生物医学图像中的散射光，并结合渐进式合成训练与跨域迁移策略降低对成对真值的依赖，适合医疗物联网嵌入式设备部署。
en_tdlr: PP-Net, a hybrid physical-prior neural network combining noise suppression, scattering map estimation, and fusion-based refinement, removes scattered light from biomedical images while reducing reliance on paired ground truth through progressive synthetic training and cross-domain transfer, making it suitable for embedded IoMT devices.
